## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run test:browser` when rendering, playground, or visual output changed
- [ ] `npm run pack:check` when package metadata, entrypoints, or release files changed

## Release and documentation

- [ ] I added a Changeset for a user-visible change, or this is unreleased housekeeping.
- [ ] I updated the README for consumer-facing changes.
- [ ] I updated architecture or other public documentation when a durable decision changed.
